text: Is this sign-in used only by the portal, or also by other company applications?
why_it_matters: A shared sign-in stays outside the assessment; a dedicated one is inside.
default_if_unanswered: Shared company sign-in, treated as an interface

text: What data is stored in the firmware bucket besides signed packages?
why_it_matters: Other data may need its own protection.
answer: Only signed packages and their manifests
